issues.on_page: Local Fees, Licenses, Commissions, and Miscellaneous 1,329,919
issues.issue: Licenses and permits is not the main part of this line. By fund it is General Fund Local 151,566 (fees of office), Road Local 30,097 (charges), Bridge Local 1,061,072 (unexplained, already in decision_needed) and other funds 28,664 (Inheritance Tax, Ambulance and Reg Deeds charges per the Statement of Activities, p2). Charges for services/fees or other would fit better. The value comes from the user's category decision (detail_category 'Licenses, Fees and Taxes').

issues.on_page: Inheritance Tax: Local 58,520; Statement of Activities Inheritance Tax charges for services 52,715 (p2)
issues.issue: The Statement of Activities shows 52,715 of the 58,520 (90%) as charges for services, so the more-than-half rule points to charges for services/fees, not other. The current value comes from the user's category decision.

issues.on_page: Reg Deeds P & M: Operating 2,130; Exhibit III Other Governmental Funds prints it under Public Works (p5)
issues.issue: The statement counts this 2,130 under Public Works (streets/highways), and the line's own review note says so. Inheritance Tax Operating, which is also under Public Works, was put in streets/highways. The two lines are categorized inconsistently (register of deeds as general government is defensible).
